blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Icons of Change International Awards 2026 is set to recognize journalists, diplomats, business and healthcare leaders as well as peace advocates on Dec. 5. The program, which will culminate the annual Icons of Change International Week for Changemakers, honors those whose work align with the United Nations’ 17 Sustainable Development Goals
